title: DITA XML Structured Content and its benefits for your business
summary: DITA (Darwin Information Typing Architecture) is an XML‑based markup suite that lets technical writers author modular topics and assemble them into maps for multi‑format publishing such as HTML, ePub and PDF. This structured, reusable approach reduces duplication, speeds updates and translation, and lets teams enforce consistent schemas, making content management and delivery more efficient for documentation groups.
